Starting Balances — Special Accounts

The Starting Balances - Special Accounts screen allows you to set up starting balances for your special accounts created under the Special Accounts tab. This is essential when transitioning to Manager.io from another accounting system or when setting up your accounts for the first time.

To create a new starting balance for a special account:

  1. Navigate to the Starting Balances - Special Accounts screen.

  2. Click the New Starting Balance button.

    SpecialAccountsNewStartingBalance

You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the selected special account. For more information on how to complete this form, see Starting Balance for Special Account Form.
